title: apex-test-failure-triager inputs
description: Exactly one evidence source is required: test_run_id or result_file/result_path. Do not guess a run id.

test_run_id.description: Existing Apex test run id. Required for live retrieve. Never use --use-most-recent.

target_org.description: sf CLI alias for live retrieve. Optional if a result file is set.

result_file.description: Path to sf apex get test --json output (fixture or CI).

project_path.description: Canonical optional Salesforce DX project root (or a file inside it) for local mapping.

method_limit.description: Bounded page size for failing methods returned to the model.
